title: This Link IS the Note 🔗

segments.text: Watch the address bar: everything you type is *packed into the link.*
segments.say: Watch the address bar. Everything you type gets compressed into the link itself.

segments.text: No account. No server. *No database.* Wait till I open it somewhere else.
segments.say: No account, no server, no database. And wait till I open it somewhere else.
Open text area dot my, type, and copy the link. That's it. Just don't put passwords in it: anyone with the link can read it.
Here it is in a brand new browser. Same note.

segments.text: *Save this.* Send someone a note — as a link.
segments.say: Save this, and send someone a note as a link.
